faizmubeen_legal_queries_data.answer_type: Human-written lawyer consultation advice (informal, advisory, directional)

faizmubeen_legal_queries_data.citations_present: 19.0% of answers contain general statutory or Act references
faizmubeen_legal_queries_data.statutes_referenced: Informally referenced in text (e.g., IPC, CrPC, Domestic Violence Act), no structured statutory metadata

IndicLegalQA.huggingface_url: Not hosted as an official HF hub standalone dataset; distributed via open GitHub legal research repositories
IndicLegalQA.source_provenance: 1,253 Indian Supreme Court judgments (spanning civil, criminal, constitutional, and commercial appeals)
IndicLegalQA.question_type: Generated reading comprehension / fact-extraction queries derived mechanically from Supreme Court judgment texts
IndicLegalQA.answer_type: Extracted text segments and verbatim factual excerpts from Supreme Court judgments
IndicLegalQA.license: MIT (repository level) / Public Legal Judgments (Indian Copyright Act s.52(1)(q) public domain judicial pronouncements)
IndicLegalQA.dataset_card_summary: Documented in tanishapritha/indiclegalqa & R-A-J-1-3/Law-Advisor as 10,000 Q&A pairs from 1,256 Indian Supreme Court cases
IndicLegalQA.citations_present: High for case names (100% include case_name and judgement_date); statutory section citations appear only when discussed in judgment excerpts
IndicLegalQA.judgments_referenced: YES: Exactly 1253 unique Indian Supreme Court judgments identified by formal cause title and date
IndicLegalQA.statutes_referenced: Incidental (provisions referenced within judgment holding excerpts)
IndicLegalQA.duplicate_rate: 3.00% identical question strings (questions like 'Who is the appellant?' repeated across different case contexts)
obvious_quality_problems: Heavy synthetic template bias: ~30-40% of questions are administrative metadata extraction ('Who is the respondent?', 'Who is the appellant?') rather than legal reasoning
Answers can be terse single-phrase responses ('The respondent is Maj. Gen. Manomoy Ganguly.') which do not teach chain-of-thought legal analysis
Lack of full judgment context: detached Q&A pairs cannot be verified without re-fetching Supreme Court full texts
Temporal transition: Historical SC judgments naturally cite repealed IPC/CrPC provisions for older appeals
IndicLegalQA.pii_risk: LOW to MEDIUM: Contains names of actual litigants in Supreme Court appeals (public judicial records, exempt from DPDP Act under judicial proceedings exemption Section 17(1)(e))
IndicLegalQA.suitability_for_training: SECONDARY_TRAINING / FILTER_FIRST (Must filter out trivial 'Who is appellant' questions and retain substantive legal doctrine & holding questions)
IndicLegalQA.suitability_for_evaluation: EVALUATION_ONLY (Excellent benchmark for judicial precedent retrieval and case law reading comprehension)

Sakib_Dalal_IndianLegal_QA.citations_present: Implicit within statutory text extracts, but no structured citation metadata fields
Sakib_Dalal_IndianLegal_QA.source_documents_identified: Document titles mentioned within text questions (e.g., 'Constitution of India', 'Customs Tariff Act'), but no document ID or URL
Sakib_Dalal_IndianLegal_QA.statutes_referenced: Extensively references Indian Constitution, IPC, CrPC, Tariff schedules
Sakib_Dalal_IndianLegal_QA.dates_available: Limited to historical amendment dates incorporated in text (e.g. 94th Amendment 2006)
obvious_quality_problems: High document-structure artifact rate: ~2.8% of sampled questions refer to document layout ('in this document', 'in Appendix I', 'in this edition', 'table 4')
Outdated criminal law: ~0.1% of sampled records reference repealed pre-2024 criminal acts (IPC/CrPC) with 0% post-2024 reform coverage (BNS/BNSS/BSA = 0)
Terse one-line extractive answers lacking practical advisory reasoning
Includes non-substantive administrative material like customs tariff codes and statutory appendix tables
Sakib_Dalal_IndianLegal_QA.pii_risk: ZERO / NEGLIGIBLE (Government statutory publications and legislative gazettes)
Sakib_Dalal_IndianLegal_QA.suitability_for_training: FILTER_FIRST (Cannot be trained naively; requires aggressive filtering to strip layout artifacts and isolate non-repealed statutes like Constitution and commercial acts)
Sakib_Dalal_IndianLegal_QA.suitability_for_evaluation: EVALUATION_ONLY (For constitutional and statutory document retrieval)

legalai_1000_realistic_lawyer_queries.source_provenance: LegalAI project synthetic curriculum generator (generate_legal_dataset.py) built on 28-domain verified Indian statutory ontology
legalai_1000_realistic_lawyer_queries.question_type: Synthetic realistic lawyer queries covering 7 practical legal dimensions (Knowledge, Scenario, Reasoning, Procedure, Comparison, Document Understanding, Ambiguous/Misconceptions)
legalai_1000_realistic_lawyer_queries.answer_type: Expert legal advisory synthesis adhering to statutory provisions, procedural rules, and educational disclaimers
legalai_1000_realistic_lawyer_queries.citations_present: 98.7% of answers contain explicit, verified statutory citations
legalai_1000_realistic_lawyer_queries.judgments_referenced: Leading constitutional & landmark Supreme Court doctrines incorporated (e.g. Maneka Gandhi, Kesavananda Bharati)
legalai_1000_realistic_lawyer_queries.statutes_referenced: Comprehensive: BNS, BNSS, BSA, Constitution of India, Companies Act, IT Act, DPDP Act, Contract Act, Consumer Protection Act, RERA, NI Act, etc. (Post-reform criminal law in 13.3% of records)
obvious_quality_problems: None structurally: 100% schema compliance, zero empty fields, zero benchmark overlap
Synthetically generated: does not capture raw ungrammatical layperson phrasing (which is by design for professional legal assistance)
legalai_1000_realistic_lawyer_queries.pii_risk: ZERO: All scenarios use generic hypothetical entities ('A retail application', 'A tenant', 'Party A')
legalai_1000_realistic_lawyer_queries.suitability_for_training: PRIMARY_TRAINING (Already validated as the core V2 LoRA training curriculum)
